gaps.term: Upper-bound model for the cited O(n log n) algorithm
gaps.quote: Since an $O(n\log n)$ algorithm exists, the open part of the conjecture is the matching lower bound
gaps.note: The page presents the cited Harvey and van der Hoeven upper bound as the existence of an O(n log n) algorithm on the multitape machines the conjecture concerns, but the page never says which machine model that bound is for. The reader cannot check that the upper bound applies to multitape machines, so cannot check that the open part is the Omega(n log n) lower bound for multitape machines.

gaps.term: Identity n log n = n(lg n)^(1-kappa) (lg n)^kappa
gaps.note: The identity needs log and lg to denote the same base-2 logarithm. The page uses both symbols and never says that log means lg. If log were the natural logarithm, the identity would fail by the constant factor ln 2, and the reader cannot tell from the page which is meant.
